leads.title: Managing Director
leads.headline: Managing Director
leads.company_description:
OLKA Sportresor AB is the largest **sports travel agency** in Scandinavia, operating as a tour operator specializing in tailor-made sports travel since 1978.[1][2][3] With over 40 years of experience, they arrange training camps, youth tournaments, football trips to top European leagues (Premier League, La Liga, Serie A, Bundesliga, Champions League), Formula 1 races, and tickets for events like NHL; packages include official tickets, hotels, and flights.[1][2][3][4] They also offer corporate travel, golf trips via Golf by OLKA to European and global destinations, and services for sports like swimming, athletics, floorball, handball, and ice hockey.[1][3]

Their target audience includes sports clubs, teams, youth groups, associations, corporate clients, and individual fans seeking high-quality sports experiences.[1][3][4]

The company mission emphasizes combining "life's two great pleasures: sports and travel," prioritizing personalized service, tailor-made arrangements, and customer satisfaction, with over 40,000-50,000 annual travelers and membership in Svenska Resebyrå- och arrangörsföreningen.[1][2][3][4][5] They focus on Europe-wide networks for competitive pricing and quality, operating in Sweden, Norway, Denmark, Finland, Germany, Poland, and Czech Republic.[1][2]

Key tour types are training camps, cups/tournaments, match spectator trips, and F1 events, with geographic specialization in Europe for football leagues, camps, and golf.[1][3][4] Unique selling points include part of family-owned Magic Carpet Group (with OLKA Express, Golf by OLKA, etc.), 200 M SEK turnover, 25+ employees (17 in 2024), and a vast European network for bespoke, affordable sports travel.[1][2][6]

leads.company_description:
Summary: **ID Travel Group** is a luxury travel wholesaler and tour operator with offices in New York, London, Johannesburg, Singapore, and Melbourne, specializing in warm-weather destinations including **Southern Europe**, Africa, Caribbean, Indian Ocean, Middle East, Southeast Asia, Fiji, South Pacific, Central America, Mexico, and USA with Hawaii[1][2][3].

Key brands and operations:
- Represents elite hotels, resorts, villas, customized safaris, flights, transfers, private tours, and concierge services for travel advisors[1][3].
- **Just Grenada Collection**: UK-based, specializes in multi-centre itineraries in Caribbean and **Slovenia** (Balkans)[1].
- **ID Vayeni AFRICA**: Africa-based team designs customized luxury safaris at camps and lodges[1][2].
- Mergers/acquisitions include CARIBTOURS (UK luxury holidays in Caribbean, Indian Ocean, Arabia, Europe) and Island Escapes (Australia's Fiji/South Pacific specialist)[2].
- Partners with networks like Virtuoso and Signature Travel Network; provides high-touch services to discerning travelers via advisors[2][3].

Focuses on hand-picked luxury properties, bespoke itineraries, and global destination expertise with on-site team experience[1][2][3].

leads.title: Travel Designer & Product Manager
leads.headline: Travel Designer & Product Manager
leads.company_description:
Hos Rejselyst vil vi opfylde drømme - store som små. Vi er et nichebureau, der skræddersyer oplevelsesrejser på tværs af prisklasser. Vores ekspertise er de oversøiske rejsemål, og hertil arrangerer vi både rejser for par, familier, solorejsende og virksomheder. Vi udvikler selv vores rejsemål. Det betyder, at vi selv har været på stederne, inden vi sender dig afsted. Vi har derfor et personligt kendskab til vores portefølje og samarbejdspartnere og vi ved, hvad vi kan tilbyde. For dig betyder det, at du får ekspertise, kvalitet, erfaring, sikkerhed og fordelagtige priser.

Vores fokus er især på hoteller, der er mere end bare et overnatningssted. Ja, faktisk vil vi gerne være med til at præge branchen i en retning, hvor ansvarlig turisme er noget, der tænkes over og tages stilling til. Derfor gør vi os ekstremt umage, når vi vælger destinationer, hoteller og udflugter. Hos Rejselyst vil du også opleve, at vi prioriterer steder med et autentisk touch fremfor store kædehoteller. Vi lægger vægt på, at hotellet tager ansvar - både for de ansatte og omgivelserne. Vores hjerter banker ubegrænset for dyrevelfærd, miljøet og ikke mindst for, at pengene investeres på en måde, så de synker dybere ned i samfundslagene på de forskellige destinationer.

leads.title: Commercial And Marketing Director
leads.headline: Commercial And Marketing Director
leads.company_description:
Continents Insolites est le spécialiste des voyages et des tours du monde sur mesure. 

Présentes en Belgique (Bruxelles) et en France (Paris, Lyon), les équipes de Continents Insolites sillonnent le monde depuis 40 ans pour vous offrir le meilleur du voyage. Nos travel designers sont de tous âges, horizons et cultures. Leur dénominateur commun : la passion de la pépite, de l'expérience exclusive qui rend un voyage unique. 

Chez Continents insolites, nous prenons le temps d'écouter nos voyageurs,  pour mieux les connaître et leur conseiller le meilleur, l'exclusif, le sur-mesure. Qu'ils partent pour un périple en famille, un voyage de noces ou un voyage en petit groupe. 

Notre force ? Notre souci du service. Pour que nos voyageurs partent l'esprit tranquille, nos équipes en France et en Belgique restent joignables à tout moment et nos partenaires sur place les accueillent et les assistent pendant toute la durée de leur séjour.

leads.title: Founder & CEO
leads.headline: Founder & CEO
leads.company_description:
Golf Globe is a **professional golf tour operator** (Golf-Reiseveranstalter) based in Hannover, Germany, specializing in customized golf travel experiences worldwide, with a strategic focus on European cities[1][4]. They offer exclusive golf hotels, spectacular courses, and tailored trips across Europe, Africa, the Caribbean, and beyond, including individual journeys, group travel, training trips with golf professionals, and pure vacation packages[4]. Key services emphasize long-term experience, strong partnerships, and personalized planning for sea, mountain, or round-trip itineraries[4].

Their **target audience** spans golf professionals, enthusiasts, and beginners, catering to unique customer wishes through bespoke offers[4]. The company mission highlights turning the world into "your fairway" with professional service, unforgettable experiences in top hotels and on premier courses, and a growing emphasis on training travels[4].

**Tour types** include individual and group golf vacations, training journeys, and themed trips (e.g., seaside, mountains, rondreisen), with geographic strengths in Europe alongside global destinations like Africa and the Caribbean[1][4]. Unique selling points for outreach: As a specialized golf travel operator with European city focus, they could benefit from Balkan DMC partnerships for novel golf itineraries in emerging regions; notable founder Mario Schomann leads operations[1][4]. (148 words)

leads.title: Founder & CEO
leads.headline: Founder & CEO
leads.company_description:
Sheenco Travel operates as a **luxury tour operator** specializing in bespoke, high-end travel, with a franchise model for US-based Luxury Travel Specialists who sell its services while the Ireland team handles operations.[1][2][3][4]

**Key offerings** include customized itineraries with private driver guides, boutique luxury hotels, exclusive castle/estate access, chauffeur/self-drive tours, golf vacations, honeymoons, train journeys, dining, sightseeing, and corporate/business trips; corporate staff manages 70% of post-sale work like bookings and on-tour support.[1][2][3][4]

**Target audience** comprises affluent US clients (90% of bookings, many with Irish/British ancestry), corporate groups, and well-heeled leisure travelers seeking personalized luxury.[1][2][4]

**Mission/About summary**: Founded in 2012 by Genevieve Sheehan, Sheenco crafts authentic, relationship-driven luxury experiences over amenities, treating clients as guests via trusted partnerships; evolved from Ireland inbound to UK expansion and US franchising.[2][3][6]

**Tour types and specializations**: Bespoke vacations/business trips focused on **Ireland, Scotland, England & Wales**; themes include castle tours, golf, chauffeur-driven, self-drive; additional destinations via third parties.[1][2][4]

leads.title: Co-owner
leads.headline: Co-owner
leads.company_description:
Kaipara Reizen operates as a specialist travel agency and tour operator, offering tailor-made and small-group luxury trips since 1997, with a focus on high-quality, self-designed itineraries to New Zealand and Scotland.[1][2][4] Key offerings include autoreizen (self-drive tours), kleinschalige groepsreizen (boutique group tours), luxe reizen (luxury trips), golfreizen, and privéreizen with private guide/chauffeur; all accommodations and excursions are personally selected for quality, service, and hospitality, with detailed custom draaiboeken (itineraries) provided.[1][2][7] They target comfort-seeking Dutch and Flemish travelers (Nederlanders en Vlamingen) desiring luxurious, personalized experiences, from 8-day short trips to 60-day extended journeys.[1][2]

The company mission emphasizes passion-driven expertise from over 20 years in the industry, designing and guiding unique, comfortable luxury travels to stunning destinations, annually scouting new special spots.[1][2][3] Tour types specialize geographically in **New Zealand** (North and South Islands, comfort/nature groepsreizen in 4-5 star accommodations) and **Scotland**, with thematic emphases on luxury, nature, golf, and boutique formats.[4][5][6][7]

Unique selling points include 25+ years of hands-on experience (founder led groups in New Zealand, Canada/USA), SGR/Calamiteitenfonds/VvKR affiliations for security, and a small-team approach ensuring maatwerk (custom-fit) for individual needs—ideal for partnerships in complementary destinations like the Balkans.[2][3] Based in Warnsveld, Netherlands.[2] (178 words)

leads.title: Chief Executive Officer
leads.headline: Chief Executive Officer
leads.company_description:
Siden 1986 har Lords Travel sørgede for at sende sine kunder ud på et eventyr, hvor de har kunne opleve en ny kultur og natur uden at komprimere på rejsekomforten, med specialisme i rundrejser til Østen, Australien og New Zealand. 

Hos LORDS TRAVEL er du sikret en ærlig og kompetent rejsevejledning. Med udgangspunkt i deres ønsker og behov er rejsen sammensat, så I får en nuanceret og dybdegående oplevelse af rejsemålet, der ligger indenfor deres budget.  Endvidere er der mulighed for at kombinere rejsen med et vores stopover pakker, hvor I kan tage en ferie i ferien. For eksmepel under solen ved mælkehvide sandstrande og turkisfarvet vand i Dubai eller i Singapore med et væld af restauranter i topklasse, et afslappet natteliv og uforlignelige kvalitetsshopping. 

Vores rejser er inddelt i fire kategorier - luxury, family, explorer og specials, som skal lede jer til lige netop det i ønsker. Og hvis I har nogle særlige ønsker eller drømme kan I hjælpes frem ved blot at kontakte en af vores rejsekonsulenter. Ellers anbefaler vi dem til at læne tilbage og
lade dig inspirere og Follow your senses.

**Operation Type:** atambo tours operates as a **tour operator and travel agency** specializing in tailor-made, sustainable travel experiences[1][2]. They function as a boutique advisor offering personalized trip planning rather than packaged tours[2].

**Key Offerings & Services:** The company specializes in honeymoons (Flitterwochen), experiential travel, art tours, destination weddings abroad, and leisure travel[1]. They provide custom-designed private trips with personal consultation and 24-hour local support through their network of partner agencies[1][2]. Services include assistance with foreign formalities for weddings and romantic ceremonies abroad[4].

**Target Audience:** Affluent travelers seeking individual, personalized vacations beyond mass tourism; couples planning honeymoons and destination weddings; culturally-oriented travelers interested in curated experiences[2].

**Company Mission:** atambo tours positions itself as a specialist for individual, sustainable travel experiences "beyond mass-tourism," emphasizing personal consultation, high service quality (five-star service from first contact), and responsible travel practices[1][2].

**Tour Types & Geographic Focus:** The company offers discovery trips, art tours following famous artists, cultural round trips, beach vacations, island hopping, and long-distance travel[1]. They emphasize expertise in South America, the Caribbean, and worldwide destinations, with demonstrated knowledge of Jersey, Andalusia, Canary Islands, and Greece[1][5].

**Notable Facts:** atambo is **CSR-Bio certified** for sustainable tourism since 2010[7], a member of "Forum Anders Reisen" (sustainable travel association)[7], and operates from Frankfurt with local expert partnerships worldwide[1][5].

weights_used.rationale: source_markets is in low_confidence_fields (partners page gave only 4-5 countries; no explicit client-country declarations), so country is capped at 8 per the rules. Noyan Golf is a golf-specialist DMC above all else - travel_type gets the top weight (22) because matching golf-focused operators is the single most important filter. destination_overlap is positive (current_buyer framing: the offer is to find operators who could send clients, meaning operators already selling Turkey/Spain/Portugal/Morocco golf packages are the prime targets) but kept moderate at 15 because the 20-destination breadth means almost any golf operator will have some overlap and we need the signal to discriminate rather than max out. icp at 18 rewards the primary target_icp_types (tour_operator > boutique_advisor > theme_tour_operator). niche_penalty at 10 penalizes clearly irrelevant niches (wine-only, polar, safari) that wouldn't naturally sell golf packages.

prospect_summary: Noyan Golf Travel is a Turkey-based golf DMC and ground operator with offices in Antalya and Paris, specializing in golf holidays across 20+ destinations including Turkey, Spain, Portugal, Morocco, Mauritius, and the UAE. Founded by Noyan Yoldan with 20+ years of experience in tourism, the company is a member of IAGTO (the global golf tourism organization) and APST (French tourism solidarity association), and was awarded Turkey's Best Inbound Golf Tour Operator in 2020. They offer multilingual service in French, English, and German, serving primarily European and Scandinavian source markets - their Paris office and French-language APST membership indicate a strong French-market focus, with confirmed partners from France, Denmark, and Estonia. They handle hotel and tee-time packages, FIT and group bookings, MICE, VIP transfers, and tailor-made golf itineraries for both inbound Turkey clients and outbound golfers to other destinations.
